14	// MarkdownRenderer renders goldmark AST back to markdown text.
15	type MarkdownRenderer struct {
16		buf *bytes.Buffer
17	}
18	
19	// NewMarkdownRenderer creates a new markdown renderer.
20	func NewMarkdownRenderer() *MarkdownRenderer {
21		return &MarkdownRenderer{
22			buf: &bytes.Buffer{},
23		}
24	}
25	
26	// Render renders the AST node to markdown and returns the result.
27	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) Render(node gast.Node, source []byte) string {
28		r.buf.Reset()
29		r.renderNode(node, source, 0)
30		return r.buf.String()
31	}
32	
33	// renderNode renders a single node and its children.
34	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderNode(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
35		switch n := node.(type) {
36		case *gast.Document:
37			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
38	
39		case *gast.Paragraph:
40			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
41			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
42				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
43			}
44	
45		case *gast.Text:
46			// Text nodes store their content as segments in the source
47			segment := n.Segment
48			r.buf.Write(segment.Value(source))
49			if n.SoftLineBreak() {
50				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
51			} else if n.HardLineBreak() {
52				r.buf.WriteString("  \n")
53			}
54	
55		case *gast.CodeSpan:
56			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
57			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
58			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
59	
60		case *gast.Emphasis:
61			symbol := "*"
62			if n.Level == 2 {
63				symbol = "**"
64			}
65			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
66			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
67			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
68	
69		case *gast.Link:
70			r.buf.WriteString("[")
71			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
72			r.buf.WriteString("](")
73			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
74			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
75				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
76				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
77				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
78			}
79			r.buf.WriteString(")")
80	
81		case *gast.AutoLink:
82			url := n.URL(source)
83			if n.AutoLinkType == gast.AutoLinkEmail {
84				r.buf.WriteString("<")
85				r.buf.Write(url)
86				r.buf.WriteString(">")
87			} else {
88				r.buf.Write(url)
89			}
90	
91		case *gast.Image:
92			r.buf.WriteString("![")
93			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
94			r.buf.WriteString("](")
95			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
96			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
97				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
98				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
99				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
100			}
101			r.buf.WriteString(")")
102	
103		case *gast.Heading:
104			r.buf.WriteString(strings.Repeat("#", n.Level))
105			r.buf.WriteByte(' ')
106			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
107			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
108				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
109			}
110	
111		case *gast.CodeBlock, *gast.FencedCodeBlock:
112			r.renderCodeBlock(n, source)
113	
114		case *gast.Blockquote:
115			// Render each child line with "> " prefix
116			r.renderBlockquote(n, source, depth)
117			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
118				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
119			}
120	
121		case *gast.List:
122			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
123			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
124				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
125			}
126	
127		case *gast.ListItem:
128			r.renderListItem(n, source, depth)
129	
130		case *gast.ThematicBreak:
131			r.buf.WriteString("---")
132			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
133				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
134			}
135	
136		case *east.Strikethrough:
137			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
138			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
139			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
140	
141		case *east.TaskCheckBox:
142			if n.IsChecked {
143				r.buf.WriteString("[x] ")
144			} else {
145				r.buf.WriteString("[ ] ")
146			}
147	
148		case *east.Table:
149			r.renderTable(n, source)
150			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
151				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
152			}
153	
154		// Custom Memos nodes
155		case *mast.TagNode:
156			r.buf.WriteByte('#')
157			r.buf.Write(n.Tag)
158	
159		case *mast.MentionNode:
160			r.buf.WriteByte('@')
161			r.buf.Write(n.Username)
162	
163		default:
164			// For unknown nodes, try to render children
165			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
166		}
167	}
168	
169	// renderChildren renders all children of a node.
170	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderChildren(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
171		child := node.FirstChild()
172		for child != nil {
173			r.renderNode(child, source, depth+1)
174			child = child.NextSibling()
175		}
176	}
177	
178	// renderCodeBlock renders a code block.
179	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderCodeBlock(node gast.Node, source []byte) {
180		if fenced, ok := node.(*gast.FencedCodeBlock); ok {
181			// Fenced code block with language
182			r.buf.WriteString("```")
183			if lang := fenced.Language(source); len(lang) > 0 {
184				r.buf.Write(lang)
185			}
186			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
187	
188			// Write all lines
189			lines := fenced.Lines()
190			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
191				line := lines.At(i)
192				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
193			}
194	
195			r.buf.WriteString("```")
196			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
197				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
198			}
199		} else if codeBlock, ok := node.(*gast.CodeBlock); ok {
200			// Indented code block
201			lines := codeBlock.Lines()
202			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
203				line := lines.At(i)
204				r.buf.WriteString("    ")
205				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
206			}
207			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
208				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
209			}
210		}
211	}
212	
213	// renderBlockquote renders a blockquote with "> " prefix.
214	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderBlockquote(node *gast.Blockquote, source []byte, depth int) {
215		// Create a temporary buffer for the blockquote content
216		tempBuf := &bytes.Buffer{}
217		tempRenderer := &MarkdownRenderer{buf: tempBuf}
218		tempRenderer.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
219	
220		// Add "> " prefix to each line
221		content := tempBuf.String()
222		lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(content, "\n"), "\n")
223		for i, line := range lines {
224			r.buf.WriteString("> ")
225			r.buf.WriteString(line)
226			if i < len(lines)-1 {
227				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
228			}
229		}
230	}
231	
232	// renderListItem renders a list item with proper indentation and markers.
233	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderListItem(node *gast.ListItem, source []byte, depth int) {
234		parent := node.Parent()
235		list, ok := parent.(*gast.List)
236		if !ok {
237			r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
238			return
239		}
240	
241		// Add indentation only for nested lists
242		// Document=0, List=1, ListItem=2 (no indent), nested ListItem=3+ (indent)
243		if depth > 2 {
244			indent := strings.Repeat("  ", depth-2)
245			r.buf.WriteString(indent)
246		}
247	
248		// Add list marker
249		if list.IsOrdered() {
250			fmt.Fprintf(r.buf, "%d. ", list.Start)
251			list.Start++ // Increment for next item
252		} else {
253			r.buf.WriteString("- ")
254		}
255	
256		// Render content
257		r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
258	
259		// Add newline if there's a next sibling
260		if node.NextSibling() != nil {
261			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
262		}
263	}
264	
265	// renderTable renders a table in markdown format.
266	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderTable(table *east.Table, source []byte) {
267		// This is a simplified table renderer
268		// A full implementation would need to handle alignment, etc.
269		r.renderChildren(table, source, 0)
270	}

Perfect! Now I have a comprehensive understanding of the markdown architecture. Let me create a final summary report.

## Markdown Processing Architecture Report

Based on my thorough search of the codebase, here's the complete markdown processing architecture:

### **INTERFACE DEFINITION (Backend - Go)**

**Location:** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`

The `Service` interface (lines 31-55) is the central abstraction for markdown processing:

```go
type Service interface {
    ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)
    ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)
    ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)
    RenderMarkdown(content []byte) (string, error)
    RenderHTML(content []byte) (string, error)
    GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)
    ValidateContent(content []byte) error
    RenameTag(content []byte, oldTag, newTag string) (string, error)
}
```

### **CONCRETE IMPLEMENTATION (Backend - Go)**

**Location:** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`

The `service` struct (lines 57-60) implements the `Service` interface:

```go
type service struct {
    md goldmark.Markdown
}
```

Uses **Goldmark** (YAML-compliant markdown parser) with:
- **GFM Extension** (GitHub Flavored Markdown - tables, strikethrough, task lists)
- **Custom Extensions** (optionally enabled):
  - `TagExtension` for `#tag` syntax parsing
  - `MentionExtension` for `@mention` syntax parsing

### **AST & EXTENSION LAYERS**

**Custom AST Nodes (Go):**
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/tag.go` - `TagNode` struct for `#tag` parsing
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/mention.go` - `MentionNode` struct for `@mention` parsing

**Goldmark Extensions (Go):**
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go` - `TagExtension` that registers inline parser with priority 200
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/mention.go` - `MentionExtension`

**Parsers (Go):**
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/tag.go` - `NewTagParser()` inline parser
- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/mention.go` - Mention parser

### **MARKDOWN RENDERER (Backend - Go)**

**Location:** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`

`MarkdownRenderer` struct renders goldmark AST back to markdown text:
- Handles all node types (Document, Paragraph, Heading, CodeBlock, List, Table, etc.)
- Preserves formatting during round-trip serialization

**Constructor:** `NewMarkdownRenderer()` returns `*MarkdownRenderer`

### **CONSTRUCTION / INSTANTIATION**

**Factory Function:**

```go
// NewService creates a new markdown service with the given options.
func NewService(opts ...Option) Service
```

**Configuration Options:**
- `WithTagExtension()` - enables `#tag` parsing
- `WithMentionExtension()` - enables `@mention` parsing

### **WHO CONSTRUCTS THE SERVICE**

1. **API V1 Service** (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, lines 47-62)
   - Creates service with both tag and mention extensions
   - Stores in `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` field

2. **Test Suite** (`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown_test.go`)
   - Multiple instantiations for testing

### **WHO USES THE SERVICE (BACKEND)**

1. **APIV1Service** (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`)
   - Field: `MarkdownService markdown.Service`
   - Handles API requests for markdown operations

2. **RSS Service** (`/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go`)
   - Field: `MarkdownService markdown.Service`
   - Passed via constructor: `NewRSSService(...markdownService)`
   - Used for server-side HTML rendering in RSS feeds

3. **MemoPayload Runner** (`/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`)
   - Field: `MarkdownService markdown.Service`
   - Passed via constructor: `NewRunner(...markdownService)`
   - Rebuilds memo payload metadata using `ExtractAll()`, `ExtractTags()`, `ExtractProperties()`

### **FRONTEND MARKDOWN RENDERER (React/TypeScript)**

**Main Renderer Component:**
- **Location:** `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx`
- **Props:** `MemoMarkdownRendererProps` includes `content`, `resolvedMentionUsernames`, `memoName`, `compact`
- **Base Library:** `react-markdown` (wraps Markdown parser + rehype/remark plugins)

**Render Context:**
- **Location:** `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MarkdownRenderContext.tsx`
- Tracks nesting depth (`blockDepth`) for nested markdown blocks

### **REMARK PLUGINS (Frontend - Custom AST Transformers)**

**Location:** `/bench/repo/web/src/utils/remark-plugins/`

1. **`remark-tag.ts`** - Transforms text nodes containing `#tag` syntax into `TagNode` elements
2. **`remark-mention.ts`** - Transforms text nodes containing `@mention` syntax into `MentionNode` elements
3. **`remark-disable-setext.ts`** - Disables setext heading syntax
4. **`remark-split-mixed-task-lists.ts`** - Handles mixed task/regular list items
5. **`remark-preserve-type.ts`** - Preserves MDAST node type metadata

### **REHYPE PLUGINS (Frontend - HTML AST Transformers)**

**Location:** `/bench/repo/web/src/utils/rehype-plugins/`

1. **`rehype-heading-id.ts`** - Generates heading IDs for anchor navigation

**Built-in Rehype Plugins (via MemoMarkdownRenderer):**
- `rehype-raw` - Allows raw HTML
- `rehype-sanitize` with custom schema - HTML sanitization
- `rehype-katex` - LaTeX math rendering

### **MARKDOWN ELEMENT COMPONENTS (Frontend)**

**Location:** `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/markdown/`

Custom React components for each markdown element:
- `Paragraph.tsx` - Paragraph rendering
- `Heading.tsx` - Heading levels 1-6
- `List.tsx` - Unordered/ordered lists
- `Blockquote.tsx` - Blockquote rendering
- `Link.tsx` - External links
- `AnchorLink.tsx` - In-page anchor links
- `InlineCode.tsx` - Inline code spans
- `Image.tsx` - Image rendering
- `HorizontalRule.tsx` - Thematic breaks

**Special Components:**
- `CodeBlock.tsx` - Fenced code blocks with syntax highlighting
- `Table.tsx`, `TableRow.tsx`, `TableCell.tsx`, etc. - Table rendering
- `TaskListItem.tsx` - Task list checkbox items
- `Tag.tsx` - Custom tag rendering with color and click handlers
- `Mention.tsx` - Custom mention rendering with resolution status

### **TYPE DEFINITIONS (Frontend)**

**Location:** `/bench/repo/web/src/types/markdown.ts`

Interfaces for custom markdown nodes:
- `TagNode` - Represents `#tag` nodes with `TagNodeData`
- `MentionNode` - Represents `@mention` nodes with `MentionNodeData`
- `ExtendedData` - Extends HAST node data with `mdastType` metadata
- Helper functions: `isTagElement()`, `isMentionElement()`, `isTaskListItemElement()`

### **COMPONENT USAGE HIERARCHY**

```
MemoContent (index.tsx)
    └── MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx
            ├── ReactMarkdown
            │    ├── Remark plugins (tag, mention, math, GFM, etc.)
            │    ├── Rehype plugins (sanitize, katex, heading-id)
            │    └── Component overrides (h1-h6, p, ul, ol, li, a, span, input, code, img, table, etc.)
            │
            ├── Custom Components:
            │   ├── Heading.tsx (h1-h6)
            │   ├── Paragraph.tsx (p)
            │   ├── List.tsx (ul/ol)
            │   ├── ListItem.tsx (li)
            │   ├── Blockquote.tsx
            │   ├── Link.tsx / AnchorLink.tsx (a)
            │   ├── InlineCode.tsx (code)
            │   ├── CodeBlock.tsx (pre/code)
            │   ├── Image.tsx (img)
            │   ├── HorizontalRule.tsx (hr)
            │   ├── Table/TableRow/TableCell/etc. (table)
            │   ├── Tag.tsx (custom span with data-tag)
            │   ├── Mention.tsx (custom span with data-mention)
            │   ├── TaskListItem.tsx (input[type=checkbox])
            │   ├── TrustedIframe.tsx (iframe)
            │   └── MermaidBlock.tsx (mermaid diagrams)
            │
            └── MarkdownRenderContext (nesting depth tracking)
```

### **WHERE MEMOMARKDOWNRENDERER IS USED**

**Location:** `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/index.tsx`

Used in:
- `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoView/components/MemoBody.tsx`
- `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoPreview/MemoPreview.tsx`
- `/bench/repo/web/src/components/PagedMemoList/PagedMemoList.tsx`
- `/bench/repo/web/src/pages/MemoDetail.tsx`
- `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoActionMenu/MemoShareImagePreview.tsx`

### **KEY DESIGN PATTERNS**

1. **Dual Processing**: Backend (Go) parses for metadata extraction; Frontend (React/TypeScript) renders for display
2. **Composable Extensions**: Goldmark extensions (backend) and Remark/Rehype plugins (frontend) enable custom syntax
3. **AST Transformation**: Custom nodes (TagNode, MentionNode) flow through parser → renderer → React components
4. **Context-Based Nesting**: `MarkdownRenderContext` tracks depth for nested block rendering
5. **Component Composition**: Each markdown element has a dedicated React component for styling and interaction
6. **Sanitization**: HTML sanitization via `rehype-sanitize` with custom schema prevents XSS
